root_causes: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts during sync.

args.impact: 11 ledger entries were mismatched at alert time, with a ledger overstatement of SAR 306865.35. Orders and payments were unaffected (27 of 27). The repair fixed 289 rows, with money_recovered SAR 7230215.52 as reported by the tool.
recommended_actions: Fix the currency handling bug in v1.4 and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying

args.summary: v1.4's sync refactor wrote wrong amounts into the ledger. I rolled back to v1.3, repaired the flagged ledger rows, and check_invariants is now green.
